mapper.insert: INSERT INTO devine_moment_comments (momentId, userId, content) VALUES (#{momentId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT dmc.commentId, dmc.momentId, dmc.userId, dmc.content, dmc.createTime, dmc.updateTime, u.nickName as userNickName, u.avatar as userAvatar FROM devine_moment_comments dmc LEFT JOIN users u ON dmc.userId = u.userId WHERE dmc.momentId = #{momentId} ORDER BY dmc.createTime ASC

SELECT dmc.commentId, dmc.momentId, dmc.userId, dmc.content, dmc.createTime, dmc.updateTime, u.nickName as userNickName, u.avatar as userAvatar FROM devine_moment_comments dmc LEFT JOIN users u ON dmc.userId = u.userId WHERE dmc.userId = #{userId} ORDER BY dmc.createTime DESC
